claims.sourceText: Chadwell memorandum to Director of Central Intelligence, subject: Flying Saucers, 11 Sep 1952 (declassified CIA document sampler)
claims.text: Chadwell wrote to the DCI on 11 September 1952 that 'the flying saucer situation contains two elements of danger which... have national security implications.'

edges.label: The flap put the CIA's science directorate onto the problem
edges.note: Within weeks of the July 1952 sightings Chadwell was writing to the DCI that reports totalled 250 in July alone and that the situation carried national security implications.

title: CUFON 1952 CIA UFO-related document sampler (Chadwell memoranda)

topics.title: The CIA and the Robertson Panel, 1952-53
